Inn at the Peachtrees, an Ascend Collection Hotel

definitions.headline_pretax: hotel_info prices.price from the FIRST priced call (Google nightly base price, pre-tax), USD, 2 adults
definitions.cheapest_refundable_pretax: min over (seller rows with free_cancellation_until) and (room-level offers with free_cancellation_until and max_visitors >= 2), pre-tax nightly; refundable_source = seller_row | room_rate. If the first call has none, the identical task is retried up to 2x and the first refundable found is used (n_refundable_from_retry)
definitions.incl_taxes_fees: Google's 'stay total with taxes + fees' / nights, parsed from the free hotel_info HTML snapshot of the same task as the headline; used only when the HTML nightly equals the JSON headline (+-$1) and nights match. Whether Google's 'taxes + fees' includes resort fees is not verified
definitions.no_rates: Google shows no bookable rates for the dates (requested dates echoed back, no price, no seller rows). Replaces v1 'sold_out'; it is not proof of a sell-out. Never retried
definitions.not_on_google: hotel has no priced cell in this whole capture (and >=1 no_rates); excluded from no_rates dots
definitions.no_price: dates echoed, seller rows present but no headline price; retried once
definitions.low_confidence: priced row with <= 2 seller rows and no official-site row; counted (n_low_confidence_excluded) but excluded from all medians
definitions.medians: over status=priced rows with low_confidence = False
definitions.no_rates_dot: n_no_rates_signal (excl. not_on_google hotels) >= 10; never set at 325d, where no-rates is structural (no_rates_structural = true)

wow.moves_rule: largest |wow_matched_pair_pct|, one per market, not thin either week, no holiday in either week's stay (wow_holiday)
wow.metric: cheapest refundable pre-tax (wow_matched_pair_pct); headline in wow_headline_pct
wow.note: stay dates move forward one week with the capture: same hotel, same relative horizon, not the same night. Baseline 2026-10-27 has no retries (first calls only).
